a: Synonyms for big include large, huge, enormous, vast.
The plural of child is children.
Past tense of go is went; past participle is gone.
Use a before consonant sounds; an before vowel sounds.
Singular subjects take singular verbs: she runs.
There is a place; their shows possession; they're means they are.
Its is possessive; it's means it is.
Fewer is for countable items; less for uncountable amounts.
Affect is usually a verb; effect is usually a noun.
